notes: Official JSR distribution, installed through the JSR npm-compatible bridge. WebAssembly LZ4 block format with a four-byte length prefix, no level option. TextEncoder.encode is in the measured call.
details: Official JSR distribution, installed through the JSR npm-compatible bridge for the same module artifact on Node, Bun and Deno. WebAssembly LZ4, block format with the uncompressed length in front as four bytes; compress takes no level or other option. TextEncoder.encode of the input string is inside the measured call.
